root_cause: The first Buffer circuit implementation used non-canonical brain_records values RuntimeState/runtime_state. Production schema only allows CurrentState/current_state, so a live 429 could fail while persisting the circuit state.
prevention: Validate brain_records record_type and record_kind against live database constraints before production writeback.
Use CurrentState/current_state for runtime provider circuit state.
Regression-test both accepted canonical values and absence of the invalid values.
Keep the Buffer circuit fail-safe: LinkedIn stays content_ready and no duplicate publication is created.
production_readback: Pending protected merge, exact-main publisher deploy and live brain_records circuit-state readback.
